reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name
FROM products p
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name FROM products s JOIN products p ON p.sister_product_id = s.product_id
SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id WHERE p.sister_product_id IS NOT NULL

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, s.product_name AS sister_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id WHERE p.sister_product_id IS NOT NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN with IS NOT NULL gives the same rows, but the inner join drops the products with no sister by itself.
